observed.caption: A tall modern CBK Pension Towers building with distinctive triangular peaks dominates an elevated daytime view over a hazy cityscape.
observed.description: The image shows a tall, modern high-rise building with three pointed grey-tiled peaks and gold structural accents, featuring a large blue glass facade with a triangular grid pattern and balconies along its sides, viewed from an elevated perspective. In the foreground a weathered dark concrete rooftop ledge is visible at the bottom edge. Surrounding the tower are smaller low-rise buildings with red and brown roofs, a white multi-story building with blue windows at the bottom right, patches of green trees and vegetation, and an elevated highway overpass curving through the midground on the right. In the background a hazy city skyline with distant high-rises stretches under a pale overcast sky.
